tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground on every screen (the riso paper). Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cream panels: callouts, system panels, unselected choice chips.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Moment cards, text fields, the tab bar, round header buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Aubergine. All text, every outline, every hard sticker shadow, the focus ring. 13:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, hints, row subtitles. On paper, card, white, lilac and pistachio (4.8:1 or more).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline and dashed row dividers, unfilled progress steps. Decoration only (1.5:1).

tokens.name: track-off
tokens.usage: Switch track when off; always paired with the 2px ink edge.

tokens.name: bluebird
tokens.usage: Every action: primary buttons, the + button, a switch that is on. Text on it is white (4.8:1). Large Bagel lettering only as text on paper.

tokens.name: on-bluebird
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on bluebird.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Italic feeling words in headlines and destructive actions. 8:1 on paper.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Fluoro rose: cheeks, hearts, the shadow under dark buttons, doodles. Never text (2.3:1 on paper).

tokens.name: cornflower
tokens.usage: Puddle's blue, header bands, the range band, book covers. Ink text on it (5.3:1).

tokens.name: cornflower-deep
tokens.usage: Puddle's wing shade only.

tokens.name: caramel
tokens.usage: Bo's fur.

tokens.name: caramel-deep
tokens.usage: Bo's paws and arms.

tokens.name: tangerine
tokens.usage: Tiggy's fur, Puddle's beak and feet, the 'today' marker on a range. Ink text on it (5.5:1).

tokens.name: tangerine-deep
tokens.usage: Tiggy's paws and arms.

tokens.name: muzzle
